title: Extending Affordance Segmentation for Wearable Robots to Multi-Object Images

problem.summary: This paper proposes a refinement to existing visionbased portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts.
statements: This paper proposes a refinement to existing visionbased portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts.
Such pipelines can effectively support automatic grasp selection and preshaping in upper-limb prosthetic devices.
However, realistic scenarios in which multiple objects are present still represent a challenge.
